content: Tinidazole is available in the following forms: Tindamax 250 mg tablets are pink, round, and scored. The tablets have TM debossed on one side and 250 on the other. They are packaged in bottles equipped with child-resistant caps. Tindamax 500 mg tablets are pink, oval, and scored. The tablets have TM debossed on one side and 500 on the other. They are also packaged in bottles with child-resistant caps. Professional sample packages are also available. The tablets should be stored at a controlled room temperature of 20-25°C (68-77°F). Temporary temperature excursions between 15-30°C (59-86°F) are acceptable. The contents must be protected from light to maintain their stability and efficacy.
